headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Cincinnati Reds dominated the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2, led by Jose Trevino's 3 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs. The Colorado Rockies routed the Miami Marlins 14-4, with Jake McCarthy contributing a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance. The Cleveland Guardians edged the Chicago White Sox 6-5, with Tim Herrin earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Jason Adam has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain, effective retroactive to June 30, 2026. Mitchell Parker has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. Matt Chapman is on the 10-day injured list with an abdominal strain, while Kris Bubic and Connor Seabold are out with left elbow soreness and a right lat strain, respectively. Corey Seager is on the 10-day injured list with lower back inflammation, and Will Vest is on the 15-day injured list with right posterior elbow inflammation. Connelly Early has been placed on the 15-day injured list with left elbow inflammation.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-hander Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen. The Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash.
